decodes.title: x402 on Base, Two Weeks Later: The Loops Kept Running
decodes.subtitle: Sep 29–Oct 5: $109,151 of x402 settled on Base; 40.6% looped back to its source. Measured the same way, Sep 15–21 was 46.8%.

decodes.title: Bankr Earned $1.74M in September. The Chain Agrees With Its Dashboard
decodes.subtitle: Fee receipts on Base and Robinhood Chain match 99.3% of Bankr's own Sep 1–28 figure. The number that's off is DefiLlama's $1.03M.

decodes.title: TermiX Collected $507K in Job Fees. 99% Came From Wallets Hiring Each Other
decodes.subtitle: 483,738 agent jobs on Base and BNB Chain, $25.4M settled. 99.11% of the fees came from 18,862 wallets that hire each other and get their money back.

decodes.title: Virtuals' Agent Commerce Earned $345,197 in March. In September: $5.48
decodes.subtitle: VIRTUAL is still the #2 AI-agent token. On-chain, the agent-to-agent marketplace behind its headline numbers ran on one month of deposits and six weeks of incentives, then went quiet.

decodes.title: Every Base MCP Transaction Ends in bmcp_blue
decodes.subtitle: We found Base MCP's on-chain tag, and it isn't the one we predicted. 12,691 tagged operations from 332 wallets since the May 26 launch; 89% of them came from 229 wallets running the same seven-protocol routine, mostly for a few cents.

decodes.title: The #2 x402 Seller on Base Funded Its Own Buyers
decodes.subtitle: One week of x402 on Base (Sep 15–21): $128,977 settled. At least $56,268 of it looped back through the seller or a closed ring, and $30,000 more was a round trip. The #2 seller had 715 buyers; at least 675 were funded from its own revenue.

decodes.title: The Honeypot Isn't in ClankerToken
decodes.subtitle: The 'Clanker Hook' tokens people search for are real Clanker launches, and most never traded. The one working trap we found is a copycat whose verified source hides a mint inside an imported library.
